title: Should I upgrade to Pixel 11 or get the cheaper Pixel 10?
metaDescription: Pixel 11 or Pixel 10? Compare chip, camera, charging and price, plus trade-in values and Android 17 features, with advice by Pixel generation you own.
excerpt: The Pixel 11 changes less than its price suggests. Here is what is actually new, what the Pixel 10 still does, and which owners should upgrade.
answer: For most Pixel 10 owners the Pixel 11 is not a worthwhile upgrade, according to Android Central and Digital Trends. The Pixel 11 adds the Tensor G6, a larger main sensor, 25W wireless charging and more base storage, while the Pixel 10 is discounted to about $599.99 in one deals list. The strongest case to upgrade is for Pixel 8 and 8 Pro owners, and for Pixel 9 owners who want the third camera lens.

sections.heading: TLDR:
sections.body:
If you own a Pixel 10 there isn't great reason to upgrade according to Android Central. "There really isn't great reason to upgrade from the Pixel 10" and "Pixel 10 is a solid flagship that you won't want to upgrade from".

The Pixel 11 does have a few upgrades. The Tensor G6 replaces the Tensor G5, the base model starts from 256GB, the main sensor is larger, the zoom is longer, and has 25W wireless charging. The Pro models also have a new 50 megapixel main camera and brighter screen. However the design is almost identical, the battery is roughly the same size, and the Pixel 10 is available at a discount.

If you own an older device then upgrading might be a good choice. Pixel 8 owners especially Pixel 8 Pro owners have the best reason to upgrade according to Digital Trends. Pixel 9 owners might benefit from upgrading to the Pixel 11 as it has the third camera lens according to Android Central.

Below is a breakdown of what changes between the two models, what Android 17 has brought to older Pixel models, the price and trade-in, and who should buy what. We have not tested either of these so everything below is based off of the sources listed.

sections.heading: Price
sections.body:
The Pixel 11 starts from $899 with 256GB. Digital Trends says the Pixel 10 started at $799 with 128GB meaning the starting price is $100 higher, but at 256GB both cost $899. According to Android Central the price has only increased on the base model due to the increase in storage.

The Pro models have a similar pricing. According to Digital Trends the Pixel 11 Pro costs the same as the Pixel 10 Pro 256GB model. This costs $1,099, while the Pro XL and the Pro Fold rose by $100. The Pro Fold costs $1,899, up from $1,799. However according to Android Central the starting price has increased by $100.

The Pixel 10 is cheaper. According to Android Central the Pixel 10 deals can be found for $599.99, down from $799.99. However prices can vary between retailers. Digital Trends mentions that the Pixel 10 can be a better choice if you can get a discounted model. The Pixel 10 Pro XL dropped to $949 earlier in the year.

Overall the Pixel 10 will be cheaper but the Pixel 11 is the newest model. Whether you want to upgrade will depend on whether you want the increased storage, faster charging and camera upgrades.

Prices can vary so make sure to check the prices online. Deals can expire and prices can have changed.

sections.heading: Chip, RAM & Storage
sections.body:
According to Android Central the Pixel 11 has a more efficient Tensor G6 chip with 20% improvements over the Pixel 10 Tensor G5. There is also 50% more performance in the TPU. According to Digital Trends Google claim there is 25% faster web browsing and 50% more TPU. These are all Google claims and we have not tested either device.

The Pixel 11 has 256GB and 512GB options whereas the Pixel 10 had 128GB and 256GB. If you're using your phone to full capacity then the base model of the Pixel 11 is more generous.

However the Pro models have a slight decrease in RAM according to Digital Trends. They go from 16GB to 12GB on the 256GB models. Only the 512GB and 1TB have 16GB. Android Central lists the Pixel 11 models as having 12GB.

Due to the Tensor G5 chip it should be able to handle most new features so the Pixel 10 will not feel outdated according to Android Central.

sections.heading: Camera
sections.body:
The Pixel 11 has the same triple camera setup as the Pixel 10 with a 48MP wide, a 13MP ultra-wide and 10.8MP 5x telephoto. However the Pixel 11 has a slightly bigger main sensor, a slightly wider angle, and can zoom up to 30x whereas the Pixel 10 can only zoom up to 20x. The Pixel 11 also has new Camera Looks and Magic Capture.

According to Digital Trends the new main sensor has a 56% larger sensor according to Google.

The Pro models have more changes. According to Digital Trends they have a new main sensor, an upgraded 48MP telephoto, 120x zoom (up from 100x) on the Pro Zoom, and 5x zoom on the Portrait Mode. According to Android Central the Pro and Pro XL have a new 50MP main camera. The ultra-wide and telephoto remain unchanged.

The camera upgrade is only a minor upgrade if you own a Pixel 10. However if you own an older device like a Pixel 8 or older then it is a bigger upgrade. If you own a Pixel 9 or older then the main reason to upgrade is the third lens according to Android Central.

sections.heading: Screen, Battery & Charging
sections.body:
Both phones have a 6.3 inch AMOLED screen with a similar brightness. The Pixel 11 does not have an LTPO screen. According to Digital Trends the Pro models have an increase in peak brightness to 3,600nits from 3,300nits. They also have a scratch resistant coating.

The battery is almost identical. Battery capacity is nearly identical, at 4,985mAh on the Pixel 11 against 4,970mAh on the Pixel 10. Digital Trends adds that the Pro batteries are slightly smaller than before, at 4,850mAh for the Pro and 5,115mAh for the Pro XL. The Pro Fold has a smaller battery of 4,806mAh from 5,015mAh.

The most obvious difference is the increased wireless charging. It can charge at 25W with Qi 2.2 whereas the Pixel 10 can only charge at 15W with Qi2. The Pixel 10 also has built-in magnets for Qi2 so this is a reason to get the Pixel 10 according to Android Central. The wired charging speed is conflicting between the text and table so we have not compared it.

In reviews of the Pixel 11 Pro we found it can last around 17.8 hours in a PCMark battery test. We could not find any similar information about the Pixel 10 so we cannot comment on whether the battery life has improved.

sections.heading: Design & Colour
sections.body:
The dimensions are identical. The Pixel 11 is slightly lighter at 6.9ounces and no longer has aluminium camera bezel. It has a glass back. According to Digital Trends it weighs 197g compared to 204g.

The Pixel 11 has Hibiscus, Frost, Obsidian and Pistachio colours. The Pixel 10 had Indigo, Frost, Lemongrass and Obsidian.

The Pro Fold has some changes. According to Digital Trends it weighs 239g compared to 258g. It is thinner when folded at 10.1mm compared to 10.8mm. It also has a ceramic outer cover glass, and an upgraded hinge. According to Google this is three times more durable.

According to Business Today the design is similar to the Pixel 9 and 10 series with the same dimensions and horizontal camera bar. The temperature sensor has been replaced with an LED called HiLight. However if you want something new then this is not a redesign year.

sections.heading: Android 17 on Older Pixels
sections.body:
One reason not to upgrade is because Android 17 is not exclusive to the Pixel 11. According to The Next Web Android 17 has been rolling out to Pixel phones since June 16th 2026. Pixel Watches also received an upgrade to Wear OS 7. The Pixel 10 can also be upgraded to Android 17 according to Android Central.

According to The Next Web the new features include Bubbles where any app can be used as a floating resizable window. Screen Reactions lets you record the front facing camera whilst recording your screen. Apps can also ask for one-time location permission. You can also share with selected contacts rather than your entire address book. Find Hub has a new feature called Mark as Lost which will lock your lost device with biometrics. Google have also reduced the number of guesses for a PIN.

Foldables (such as the Pixel 10 Pro Fold) have a permanent bubble bar, a gaming layout that splits the inside screen in half with a virtual gamepad. Native controller remapping allows users to change the button positions without any help from developers.

Gemini Intelligence is a separate upgrade. According to The Next Web it was going to be released on the Galaxy S26 and Pixel 10 line this summer. It is only available on select advanced devices according to Google. However Google have not mentioned what features will be available at launch and what will be available later. Android 17 is a refinement and there are no changes to the interface.

The June Pixel Drop added new conversational editing in Google Photos for the Pixel 10 Pro, Pro XL, Pro Fold and 10a. This was initially released to Germany, the UK, France, Spain and Italy. It also added Quick Share with AirDrop compatibility to the Pixel 9a and 8a. This means that the software gap between the Pixel 10 and 11 is not as big as the hardware marketing suggests.

sections.heading: Features not on the Pixel 10
sections.body:
The Creator Suite is currently only available on the Pixel 11. However according to Digital Trends Google may add features to older devices in future updates.

The Pixel 11 has new camera features. According to Android Central there are new features including Magic Capture, Camera Looks and Circle to Search built into the camera. Gemini Intelligence is the main feature and includes an agentic feature. However this is only available in the US.

The Pro models have a new Titan M3 security chip and 6 months of Google AI Pro. They also have HiLight.

If you want any of these features then upgrading could be a good choice. However if you're upgrading purely because it's new there is plenty of evidence that the Pixel 10 will still hold up.

sections.heading: Pixel 11 Pro Reviews
sections.body:
Reviews of the Pixel 11 Pro can help you see what you're paying for. According to 91mobiles it scored 8.4/10. It's a competent phone but not outstanding. "It's not quite good enough to tempt us to upgrade from the Pixel 10 Pro".

The AnTuTu score was 1,421,232. This is a lot slower than the two rival flagship phones which can reach 3.4-3.5 million. However in general it runs smoothly. Business Today also mentions that it has smooth multitasking but can get quite hot and there is a slight drop in performance during long gaming sessions.

The battery life was 17.8 hours in the PCMark test and around 6 hours of screen on time. This is not as good as the 7-8 hours we expect now. Business Today mentions that heavy users may get 15-16 hours. Both reviews do not directly compare with the Pixel 10 Pro.

Both reviews mention that the AI features are impressive. Business Today mentions the impressive integration of Gemini. 91mobiles mentions Rambler, Camera Coach and Magic Capture. If you're looking at upgrading for the AI features then check which ones run on your current Pixel.

sections.heading: Quick Checklist
sections.body:
Work out what is bothering you about your current phone. If you're bothered by the battery life, storage or an old slow chip then upgrading could help. If you're just curious then according to the sources it's best to save your money.

Check how old your phone is. If you own a Pixel 8 or 9 with an old battery then upgrading could be a better choice.

Compare the price of the same storage. The Pixel 11 base model starts with 256GB so compare it to the 256GB Pixel 10.

Check the trade-in. A discounted Pixel 10 with no trade-in may be cheaper than a Pixel 11 with a trade-in.

Work out what features you'll actually use. Whilst HiLight, Magic Capture, Camera Looks and the agentic Gemini feature sound interesting, the last one is only available in the US. The first one was also mentioned as being limited by reviewers.

If you're buying second hand check the battery health and how many updates are left. The Pixel 10 has 7 years of OS updates according to Android Central so will be supported for a long time.

sections.heading: Trade-in Values
sections.body:
According to Digital Trends the Pixel 11 can be traded in for $500 for a Pixel 10, $600 (Pro) and $700 for a Pro XL and up to $1,000 (Pro Fold). These are trade-ins for buying a Pixel 11 so will reduce the price.

Work out what it will cost. A Pixel 11 at $899 with a $500 credit for a Pixel 10 works out to $399 in extra cost. Whether this is worth it depends on how much you want the extra storage, charging and camera features. We're keeping it simple so have not taken taxes, conditions or offer terms into account.

Trade-in offers can vary a lot and often have conditions on the phone.

sections.heading: Advice Based on Phone Owned
sections.body:
Pixel 10 / Pixel 10 Pro Owners: According to Digital Trends there is no good reason to upgrade from the Pixel 10. There isn't much reason to upgrade if you own a Pro or Pro XL. However heavy photographers may be tempted. If you own a Pixel 10 Pro Fold you should keep it for another year.

Pixel 9 Owners: According to Digital Trends you'll need a specific reason to upgrade. The new camera hardware is a reason. According to Android Central Pixel 9 or older owners may find it worth upgrading for the third camera lens.

Pixel 8 Owners: This is the best reason to upgrade according to Digital Trends. Especially if you own a Pixel 8 Pro. However a discounted Pixel 10 could be almost as good.

If you're unsure work out what you'd notice on day one. The wireless charging is faster, you can zoom a little more and the base has more storage. However these are only small changes and the rest are refinements according to reviews.

Buying new: Android Central says the Pixel 11 is a good option if the higher price is manageable. If you want to spend less, the Pixel 10 is cheaper, has 7 years of OS updates and has built-in magnets for Qi2.

sections.heading: What We Could Not Confirm
sections.body:
Exact Prices: The price has been mentioned differently between Android Central and Digital Trends. Prices can vary between retailers.

Battery Life: We could not find any like-for-like testing.

Creator Suite and other Pixel 11 Features on Older Pixels: Digital Trends expect this to be the case however we could not find anything from Google.

Performance Improvements: These are Google claims.

We have not tested either of these. Android Authority had comparison pages but we did not open them.

faq.q: Should I upgrade to Pixel 11 from Pixel 10?
faq.a: No mostly. According to Android Central and Digital Trends there isn't much reason to upgrade.
Pixel 8 owners especially Pixel 8 Pro owners have the best reason to upgrade according to Digital Trends. Pixel 9 or older owners may benefit from the third camera lens according to Android Central.

faq.q: How much more expensive is Pixel 11?
faq.a: The starting price is $100 higher because the 128GB tier is gone, but at 256GB both cost $899 according to Digital Trends and Android Central.

faq.q: How much is the Pixel 10 now?
faq.a: The Pixel 10 can be found for $599.99, down from $799.99 in deals according to Android Central. However prices can vary between retailers.
Yes. According to Android Central it can be upgraded to Android 17 from Android 16. According to The Next Web it started rolling out on June 16th.

faq.q: How much is the Pixel 10 worth?
faq.a: Digital Trends lists $500 toward a Pixel 11 for a Pixel 10, with $600 for a Pro and $700 for a Pro XL.
The wireless charging has increased to 25W. The Tensor G6 is also faster according to Google with 50% more TPU.
